## AC-v0.4-01 — AgentInvocation exists — PASS

AgentInvocation is the frozen, backend-agnostic request contract (runner/model/prompt/paths/flags). A recording backend receives the exact invocation unchanged and it is never mutated by the instrumented path. Delivered earlier in v0.4; Prompt 24 only audits it.

Evidence:

- `runners/models.py::AgentInvocation`

- `docs/agent-invocation-contract.md`

## AC-v0.4-02 — AgentResult exists (unknown tokens/cost stay None) — PASS

AgentResult is the structured backend outcome. Unknown token counts and cost stay None (omitted, not fabricated) while genuinely-observed zeros are retained, proving None means 'unknown' rather than 'zero'.

## AC-v0.4-05 — Registry with structured errors — PASS

RunnerRegistry resolves a runner name to a backend through lazy factories and raises a structured error hierarchy: UnknownRunnerError (unrecognized name with the supported set), InvalidRunnerNameError (blank/non-string), and RegistryConfigurationError (bad factory wiring).

Evidence:

## AC-v0.4-06 — Failover is an isolated concern — PASS

Failover is an isolated concern layered over the registry: FailoverPlan is a validated ordered route list and FailoverExecutor runs the primary, resolving later routes only when an earlier attempt is eligibly failed. It never resolves later backends on success.

Evidence:

- `runners/failover.py::FailoverPlan`
- `runners/failover.py::FailoverExecutor`

## Documented exceptions / deferred boundaries

No criterion is recorded as `exception` or `fail`; all 20 pass. Three criteria pass with an honest audit note describing a deliberately-bounded scope, mirroring how v0.3 documented its deferred integration seams:

- **AC-v0.4-15** — the typed loaders/collector are adopted at the live workflow boundaries (`LiveArtifactCollector`); a wholesale deletion of every historical ad-hoc parser is a deferred cleanup, not part of this milestone.
- **AC-v0.4-16** — centralized, traversal-safe evidence path resolution lives in `eval/evidence_paths.py::TrialEvidencePaths` (with per-stage helpers in `core/steps.py`), not in `artifacts/evidence.py`.
- **AC-v0.4-17** — eval reports and evidence expose `ArtifactRef` at the contract + boundary level (`to_artifact_ref` on each evidence artifact, registered via `EVIDENCE_ARTIFACTS`); a full runtime migration of every historical eval-report writer is deferred.

## Definition of done

v0.4 "Clean Runner and Artifact Layer" is complete: a typed runner layer (invocation/result/backend/adapters/registry/failover/lifecycle with safe hashing) and a typed artifact layer (ArtifactRef, payload contracts, structured validation, stage declarations, artifact lifecycle events, and live-boundary collection) exist, are exercised by fake-backed and isolation-probed tests, and are documented. All twenty canonical acceptance criteria (`AC-v0.4-01`..`AC-v0.4-20`) are `pass` and this audit self-reports `pass` overall.
